title.purpose: Opening paragraph under a section title, in paper, max 34em.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase for column heads, fact labels, nav, codes and times.

display-small.purpose: 404 title; also the next-row title tiles on case pages.

support-lg.purpose: Fact values, service and engine-room descriptions, hobby text, held-work note.

support.purpose: Hints, handles, footer text, small headings such as the form title.

support-sm.purpose: Form privacy, field errors, footer hints. Floor for readable prose.

label-sm.purpose: Column heads, fact labels, field labels.

flap-role.purpose: Role line under the hero name.

shadows.name: photo-drop

shadows.name: dialog

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state transition, reveal and hover.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Mobile menu clip and outgoing view transition.

motion.name: flap-stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between neighbouring tiles (24ms default, 55ms for the hero name).

motion.name: button-flap

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Page navigation: fade and 14 to 22px vertical shift.

annotation.purpose: Drafting notes on dimension lines and line objects only, always inside aria-hidden decoration. Not a text size; deliberately absent from the frontmatter ramp so 10px on readable text stays flagged.

extensions.tileScaleNote: Tiles size by context: font size sets the em; --tw (about 0.72 to 0.9), --th (about 1.08 to 1.5), --gap and --r set proportions in em.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow plate with condensed caps; a paper flap falls over it on hover.
components.html: Read the case study
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; padding: 2px 24px 0; background: #ffcf33; color: #150b26; font: 800 21px/1 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: #f4efe6; transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover::before, .ds-btn:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn .ds-icon { transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-icon { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcf33; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Paper text over a yellow underline that retracts on hover.
components.html: View on GitHub
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #f4efe6; font: 600 18px/1.6 'Sofia Sans Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; background: linear-gradient(#ffcf33, #ffcf33) left bottom / 100% 2px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 0.3s; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: #ffcf33; background-size: 0 2px; background-position: right bottom; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcf33; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Line Field
components.description: An underline, not a box; a yellow line draws in on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; background: #150b26; padding: 16px; } .ds-field span { font: 450 11px/1.4 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9283b8; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-field:focus-within span { color: #ffcf33; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: #f4efe6; font: 400 20px/1.4 'Sofia Sans Variable', sans-serif; caret-color: #ffcf33; background: linear-gradient(#ffcf33, #ffcf33) left bottom / 0 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(rgb(179 165 212 / 0.28), rgb(179 165 212 / 0.28)) left bottom / 100% 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #9283b8; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; background-size: 100% 2px, 100% 1px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Mono uppercase lilac link with a yellow underline drawn from the left.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 34px; background: #150b26; padding: 16px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 8px 0; font: 450 12px/1 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b3a5d4; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #ffcf33; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.is-active { color: #f4efe6; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcf33; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Split-Flap Tiles
components.description: Signature element: one tile per character, split at the middle with a near-black seam.
components.css: .ds-flap { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.06em; font: 800 72px/1 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffcf33; background: #150b26; padding: 16px; } .ds-f { position: relative; width: 0.78em; height: 1.1em; } .ds-f::before, .ds-f::after { content: attr(data-c); position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 50%; overflow: hidden; display: flex; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.1em; } .ds-f::before { top: 0; align-items: flex-start; background: linear-gradient(#2a1a45, #221539); border-radius: 0.12em 0.12em 0 0; } .ds-f::after { bottom: 0; align-items: flex-end; background: #1a1030; border-top: max(1px, 0.035em) solid #070310; border-radius: 0 0 0.12em 0.12em; }

components.name: Departure Row
components.description: Timetable row; hover lays a faint yellow plate and grows a left yellow bar.
components.html: 2025#01 Cookies ClickerGame devDeparted
components.css: .ds-dep { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px 1.7fr 1.3fr 1.15fr; gap: 20px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 4px; background: #150b26; text-decoration: none; font: 800 20px/1.28 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-dep__c { color: #ffcf33; } .ds-dep__l { color: #b3a5d4; } .ds-dep::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 3px; height: 0; background: #ffcf33; border-radius: 2px; transition: height 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), top 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-dep:hover { background: linear-gradient(rgb(255 207 51 / 0.05), rgb(255 207 51 / 0.05)), #150b26; } .ds-dep:hover::before { top: 16%; height: 68%; } .ds-dep:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcf33; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Language Tiles
components.description: Two small flap tiles; the current language is yellow.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: flex; gap: 4px; font: 800 17px/1 'Sofia Sans Extra Condensed Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; background: #150b26; padding: 16px; } .ds-lang a { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 34px; color: #9283b8; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(#2a1a45, #221539 50%, #070310 50%, #070310 calc(50% + 1px), #1a1030 calc(50% + 1px)); transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-lang a:hover { color: #f4efe6; } .ds-lang a[aria-current='true'] { color: #ffcf33; } .ds-lang a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffcf33; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Fact Row
components.description: Platform facts: mono label and value separated by hairlines, never boxed.
components.css: .ds-facts { margin: 0; background: #150b26; padding: 16px; width: 320px; } .ds-facts div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 108px 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; background: linear-gradient(rgb(179 165 212 / 0.13), rgb(179 165 212 / 0.13)) left bottom / 100% 1px no-repeat; } .ds-facts dt { font: 450 11px/1.9 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9283b8; } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0; font: 400 16px/1.6 'Sofia Sans Variable', sans-serif; color: #f4efe6; } .ds-facts dd.y { color: #ffcf33; }

narrative.overview:
The whole site is one station departures board for a single route, Aruba to Rotterdam and onward. Projects are departures, the next build is boarding, earlier work is held at the gate, and possible future roles are scheduled. Characters live on split-flap tiles that clatter into place; the board housing is a deep aubergine, the characters signal yellow, and the running prose a warm white. Behind everything sits a low-key drafting layer: a blueprint grid that bends toward the pointer, dimension lines with measurements, and thin line drawings of maths, tech and sports objects.

Density is that of a timetable: rows, rules and tiles, read left to right in columns, with generous vertical breathing room between platforms. Content is never boxed. Separation comes from 1px hairline rules, a darker band behind alternate sections, and column alignment. Data (times, codes, years, stacks) is set in a monospace; everything a passenger would read from across the hall is set in heavy extra-condensed capitals.

Motion is mechanical and short: tiles flip in 62ms half-turns with a slight stagger, so rows settle like a real board rather than fading in. Everything else eases out on one curve.
keyCharacteristics: Split-flap tiles as the signature element, for the name, project numbers, departure rows, clocks, the mobile menu and the logo.
Aubergine housing in four steps, signal yellow as the single accent, lilac and dim violet for secondary text.
Three typefaces with strict jobs: extra-condensed display, humanist sans prose, mono data.
Rules and hairlines instead of boxes; one 4px radius everywhere a corner shows.
Blueprint drafting marks (grid, dimension lines, corner brackets, measurement notes) as the ambient layer.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only accent on the board (the scoped terminal palette excepted). It marks what is live (a character, a status, a call to action, a focused field); everything else is aubergine, paper or lilac.

rules.name: The Housing Rule
rules.body: Surfaces step only within the aubergine family (board-deep to board-3). Depth comes from changing the housing tone, not from a new hue.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Display face for anything on a tile or a sign, sans for sentences, mono only for data, codes, times and labels. Never set prose in mono or labels in the display face.

rules.name: The All-Caps Board Rule
rules.body: Display and tile text is always uppercase; prose never is.

rules.name: The Tile Scale Rule
rules.body: A new tile context picks the nearest step on the tile scale and tunes proportions through the tile ratios, not through a new font size.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Text, rows, tiles and buttons carry no shadow. Only screenshots, toasts and dialogs lift.

dos: Do put names, numbers, statuses and short codes on split-flap tiles; that is the board's voice.
Do keep yellow for live things only: characters, statuses, calls to action, focus and emphasis inside a title.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines (line or line-strong), column alignment and the deep band behind alternate sections.
Do set times, years, stacks, codes and labels in Martian Mono uppercase at 11 to 12px with 0.12em tracking.
Do frame images with drafting marks (dimension lines, corner brackets) and a 4px corner.
Do respect reduced motion: flips and transitions collapse to instant.
donts: Don't box content in bordered cards; the terminal dialog's 1px hairline is the only stroked container.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; status and emphasis stay yellow, secondary text stays lilac or dim.
Don't put shadows on text, rows, tiles or buttons.
Don't set prose in the condensed display face or in mono.
Don't draw fields as boxes; inputs are underlines.
